svg.title: EP2 C1 AREA 06
svg.desc: Same colour: a switch and its barrier Timed switch Light switch Healing Barrier / trap Boxes (number = supply count) Warp pair (A → A′) Room 2: hold the pad for one player to take west A. The others enter east B together to pass the narrow Belra hall. West: far pad in the room, then near pad in the hall. East: choose far in the first pair, near in the second to release each other. Room 5: hold for the team to warp. The south pad triggers two fire traps and enemies; keep holding until everyone crosses. East hall: overlapping stompers deal 100 fixed damage. Even full HP may be insufficient; cross between drops. Room 7: break the third barrier from the entrance and go south to D. Wrong lanes trigger extra traps. Room 8: clear the lilies, use the outer walkway around the stompers and go north to E. Use remaining damage/confuse traps on room 11’s waves; freeze room 13’s three Dark Belras before the boss.
